plant.configure.function_zh: 可信宿主初始化数值响应和显式气氛选件

sample.load.function_zh: 装载无损样品；已知组成仅限宿主

sample.unload.function_zh: 把未消耗样品完整返回宿主

cover.set.function_zh: 可信宿主开盖立即停止辐射和采集；真空需先回填

power.set.function_zh: 设定电源；管压流及SDD冷却仅step推进

method.configure.function_zh: 设置管压流、能量轴和完整积分窗；谱线必须满足壳层吸收边

filter.select.function_zh: OPEN+五未知材料滤位；有限选位，不捏造原厂透射曲线

collimator.select.function_zh: 选择1/3/5/10mm样品照射斑；准直片实体孔径未知，有限工程选位

atmosphere.set.function_zh: 空气/显式安装选件的有限抽气、He置换、回填；真空液体拒绝

measurement.start.function_zh: 闭盖后非破坏能谱采集；只完整时间窗生成合成整数计数

measurement.stop.function_zh: 停止辐射，保留已完整采样窗口及全部样品

process.measure.function_zh: 纯读过程与实际观测推断

result.read.function_zh: 纯读当前结果，保留当时方法与谱数组

spectrum.read.function_zh: 同时能量通道的累计计数谱，非顺序质量扫描

spectrum.cursor.function_zh: 设置能谱游标，不选择光子或改采集

result.export.function_zh: 导出真实运行数组字符串，包含J和计数单位

blank.read.function_zh: 匹配响应方法的实际空白谱

calibration.fit.function_zh: 真实标准参考+实际公开谱形分解净率拟合；同基体响应为显式接受前提

calibration.select.function_zh: 选择全响应签名相容标线

calibration.read.function_zh: 读取原始标准观测与拟合

records.list.function_zh: 实例独立结果/标线目录

records.read.function_zh: 读取冻结历史谱和方法

records.remove.function_zh: 删除指定缓存结果；异步历史仍受权限保护

template.read.function_zh: 纯读真实线/边与组成参考，未知响应分开

product.read.function_zh: 仅可信宿主读取无损质量、气体和能量代理账本

plant.configured.meaning_zh: 宿主模型已配置；由运行层模型推导，显示于宿主SI遥测板；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

sample.loaded.meaning_zh: 样品已装载；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

power.enabled.meaning_zh: 电源目标；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

cover.opened.meaning_zh: 样品盖已开启；场景状态，由宿主登记，不由过程模型推导。

cover.angle_rad.meaning_zh: 后铰链黑色上盖（sample_lid）宿主立即重定位的盖工程转角，范围 0–1.48 rad；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

filter.id.meaning_zh: 当前目标滤位，材料未公开；设定值，由 filter.select 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

filter.position_m.meaning_zh: 六位滤片直条（filter_slide）六滤位直条工程位移，仅step有限移动，范围 0–0.06 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

collimator.diameter_m.meaning_zh: 样品照射斑直径目标；非实体准直片实测孔径，范围 0.001–0.01 m；设定值，由 collimator.select 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

collimator.position_m.meaning_zh: 四档准直孔直条（collimator_slide）四照射斑选位直条的工程位移，范围 0–0.045 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

tube.actual_voltage_v.meaning_zh: 实际管压的有限宿主代理，范围 0–50000 V；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

tube.actual_current_a.meaning_zh: 实际管流的有限宿主代理，范围 0–0.001 A；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

detector.temperature_k.meaning_zh: SDD电子冷却热惯性代理，非厂家温度标定，范围 220–310 K；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

xray.emitting.meaning_zh: 采集中辐射使能，开盖即关；不是X射线剂量安全认证；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

atmosphere.mode.meaning_zh: 气氛目标，He/真空必须显式安装；设定值，由 atmosphere.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

atmosphere.pressure_pa.meaning_zh: 腔体绝压宿主理想气体模型，范围 0–120000 Pa；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

atmosphere.helium_fraction.meaning_zh: 腔内He摩尔分数代理，范围 0–1；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

atmosphere.ready.meaning_zh: 达到方法的气氛阈值；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

instrument.ready.meaning_zh: 管压流、SDD和光路/气氛已满足采样要求；由运行层模型推导，显示于宿主SI遥测板；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

measurement.phase.meaning_zh: 当前测量执行状态；由运行层模型推导，显示于宿主SI遥测板；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

measurement.elapsed_s.meaning_zh: 当前测量累计时间，≥0 s；由运行层模型推导，显示于宿主SI遥测板；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

measurement.progress.meaning_zh: 完成积分时间占比，范围 0–1；由运行层模型推导，显示于宿主SI遥测板；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

measurement.completed_repeats.meaning_zh: 完整重复次数，范围 0–20；由运行层模型推导，显示于宿主SI遥测板；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

detector.count_rate_s_inv.meaning_zh: 最近完整同时谱窗口的总计数率；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

detector.last_sample_time_s.meaning_zh: 最近完整谱窗口终点；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

spectrum.current_energy_j.meaning_zh: 用户谱图游标，不代表顺序采样能量，范围 0–0 J；设定值，由 spectrum.cursor 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

result.mass_fraction.meaning_zh: 第一选线实际观测标线推断质量分数，未定义null；由运行层模型推导，显示于宿主SI遥测板；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

equations: Emax=e*V; fluorescence only when Eedge<Emax, not merely Eline<Emax.
Nonparalyzable common live fraction=1/(1+sum(rate)*tau); complete-window integer counts, inverse net rate from observed counts and matched blank through public-library spectral decomposition.
Observed decomposed profile response=slope*reference_mass_fraction+intercept; >=3 actual reference concentrations, interpolation only.
Specimen registered_mass=loaded_mass+returned_mass for each modeled element and total; irradiation is nonconsumptive.
Ideal gas n=P*V/(R*T); fixed-volume exponential pump/backfill and well-mixed He replacement. Input+initial=chamber+exhaust.
Tube electrical energy=wall loss+sample absorbed Xray energy+escaped Xray energy under explicit host fractions.

limitations: 日文features表滤片F2有效能区2–4keV、F4为7–13keV；英文同型号visual_filters.jpg分别2–5及5–13keV，原始两版均保留，任务主来源日文优先；均不当成滤材、谱透射率或硬截止阈值。
三张调研表未区分气氛选件；官方spec脚注明确真空、氦气、12样转盘和0.3mm准直为option。运行气氛必须由宿主明确已安装标记与设施参数启用，不自动声称标准配置。
最大样质量5kg仅单样本体；12位选配转盘上限为每样0.2kg、总2.4kg，不可把5kg放每转盘位置。当前无12位转盘。
样品室300W×275D×约100H mm排除圆角；3维最大值不是任意300×275×100长方体均能装入的承诺。
源管压4–50kV与管流1–1000µA为各项规格；未给联合功率限制曲线，不能推断任何边界组合均获厂家许可，也不将AC100V/15A插座容量当X射线管额定功率。
EDX-7200安装图沿用edx-7000_8000目录图，当前页面引用有效但不是本机CAD计量；仅安装布局、外泵/控制盒分离与本体尺寸可对应。
Na–U是分析范围，Na/Mg在空气和膜杯内吸收明显；厂features建议Mg及以下使用真空/He，Ca及以下受杯膜吸收，不把元素范围等同空气下各元素检出限或准确度。
谱线发射能量不同于吸收边激发阈值；最大50kV不能激发所有高Z元素K线，高Z分析需合适L等系列，能谱轴用J并明确keV换算。
厂家最高30倍计数率和最高6倍检出限改善属于相对EDX-720的特定比较，不是本机通用计数增益、噪声标准差或检出限常数。

Rh X-ray tube4–50kV,1–1000uA and element Na–U are documented; SI input V/A, photon energy J. Shell edge rather than emission energy sets excitation threshold. Current spectrum uses reference K/L line centers, synthetic equal host line yields/Gaussian response; no measured original spectrum, atomic yield derivation or OEM FP algorithm.

Five filter materials and transmission curves unknown; OPEN/F1–F5 host scalar attenuation is not a material model or hard source-energy cutoff.1/3/5/10mm are irradiation spot diameters, not documented slide aperture bores. Filter/collimator linear slides and cover geometry have source support; local pitch/travel and motor rates engineering assumptions.

Source composition values and prepared/assigned references are kept apart from generated integer counts. Unknown unreported element contribution is unmodeled, not evidence of absence. Public-catalog spectrum least-squares decomposition separates modeled overlapping K/L profiles and compensates assumed atmosphere attenuation; candidate elements never depend on hidden composition. No automatic chemical identification, matrix absorption/enhancement correction, isotope discrimination or certified XRF accuracy.

Solid/powder/sealed liquid mass and modeled element masses are preserved; unknown mass remainder is not presumed oxygen. Host reference_fraction describes explicit homogeneous admixture, not an OEM solid dilution function. Mass does not scale thick homogeneous response; surface, film, thickness and matrix factor are uncalibrated host assumptions. Same response conditions must be accepted for calibration.

Air standard. Vacuum/He require explicit host-installed options and positive facilities, default absent; no external pump geometry or electronic installation verification. Liquid vacuum rejected. Finite ideal fixed-volume pump/vent/He displacement uses absolute host reference pressure and temperature; true leak, air contamination, pump curves and He spectroscopy not calibrated.

SDD electronically cooled source; target temperature, thermal response, voltage/current ramps, Poisson counts, dead time, saturation, width, yields and noise are host assumptions. Global nonparalyzable deadtime model and simultaneous energy bins; no real detector electronics, pulse pileup, escape peaks or filter-material atomic calculations.

Only step advances physical time/RNG. Complete simultaneous spectrum windows are published; stop/cover/power retain complete windows and all specimen mass. Partial-window irradiation energy is kept but incomplete counts not reported. Owner-protected operation snapshots survive later measurements and result deletion; process-local256results/32curves/2000windows are engineering limits, not OEM persistence.

Tube electrical energy splits into assumed wall loss/X-ray/sample absorption/escape proxies. Photon counts are synthetic detector observations including electronic background; no claim they close a photon-by-photon radiation balance or establish dose/shielding safety. Cover instant trusted-host repositioning; low-pressure opening refused until vented.
